body: This 2025 Sprinter AWD 170 in our El Capitan Tier is built to feel like a warm cabin on wheels while still delivering serious adventure capability. With premium power, a full kitchen, indoor shower, climate control, Starlink connectivity, smart storage, and a flexible bench-to-bed layout, this build is made for comfortable travel in every season. The rugged exterior package, upgraded suspension, all-terrain tires, lighting, awning, and rear storage make it ready for remote campsites, long road trips, and everything in between.
